post.caption:
An octopus has a central brain plus eight arm clusters, and two thirds of its neurons are in the arms, so each arm partly thinks for itself. Copper-based blood makes it blue, and it has three hearts. Our last common ancestor was a worm 500 million years ago, so this intelligence evolved entirely separately.
